method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Water Services Act 2012 (WA) (No. 24 of 2012), compilation with amendments to the Statutes (Repeals and Minor Amendments) Act 2025 s 8 (in operation 26 Sep 2025), as deposited at registers/source-bundle/mrdoc_48881.txt (legislation.wa.gov.au mrdoc 48881, retrieved 2026-09-07). No regulations, code of practice or code of conduct deposited: tariffs, interest and late-payment penalties, exemptions and concessions, prescribed restoration fees and hardship rules are inputs or pointers.

checks.result: 158 assertions satisfied (39 baseline + 119 Q&A layer), 0 errors, 0 warnings in all four files; l4 check wsa-qa.l4: Check succeeded; parameter script: 29 questions, my role first in each, every shared parameter identical in type and @desc, each situation straight after the role, no DEONTIC or EVENT input (2026-11-06)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: Part 5 water service charges from the seat of the property owner: who may charge (s 123), the owner's entitlement (s 73), charges before connection (s 124(2)(c)), owner or tenant liability (ss 124(2)(d), 125, 126(1)), agreements binding a later owner (s 76), memorial against dealings (s 128), late payment (s 124(2)(n)), cutting off or reducing supply and restoration (s 95), interruptions (s 77), meters and entry (ss 79, 129), hardship and concessions as pointers (ss 27(3)(e), 124(2)(o), 222(2)(c)), the water services ombudsman (ss 68, 69). Licensing, last resort supply, development control, infrastructure contributions, connections, enforcement, works, entry generally, proceedings and administration are out.
